related_questions.question: What credit card is Elan Financial?

text_blocks.snippet: Elan Financial Services is a credit card issuer that partners with banks and credit unions to offer branded credit cards. They don't issue cards directly to consumers under their own name, but rather provide the credit card program, including the processing and service, for other financial institutions. So, when you see a credit card with a bank or credit union's name, it might be issued by Elan Financial Services.

list.title: Elan is a behind-the-scenes partner:
list.snippet: They don't have their own consumer-facing credit card brand, like Visa or Mastercard.

list.title: They partner with banks and credit unions:
list.snippet: Elan provides the credit card program, including the technology and services, for other financial institutions.

list.title: Examples of Elan-issued cards:
list.snippet: The Fidelity® Rewards Visa Signature® Card is issued by Elan Financial Services on behalf of Fidelity.

list.title: You'll see the bank/CU's name:
list.snippet: The card you carry will likely have the name of the bank or credit union on it, not "Elan Financial Services".

list.title: Check card terms for Elan:
list.snippet: If you're unsure, check the terms and conditions of your card. You may see a line stating that Elan Financial Services is the creditor and issuer, according to Credit Karma.
